rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something without a purpose or clear direction.

example.english: I was tidying things up aimlessly at home, without even knowing what I was looking for.
example.traditional: 我冇目的咁喺屋企執嘢，執完都唔知自己想搵乜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 muk6 dik1 gam3 hai2 uk1 kei2 zap1 je5 zap1 jyun4 dou1 m4 zi1 zi6 gei2 soeng2 wan2 mat1

rows.note: Use this when someone is wandering or moving around without a destination, rather than for every kind of purposeless action.

example.english: I walked around aimlessly all afternoon without knowing where I had gone.
example.traditional: 我周圍咁行，行咗成個下午都唔知自己去咗邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zau1 wai4 gam3 haang4 haang4 zo2 seng4 go3 haa6 ng5 dou1 m4 zi1 zi6 gei2 heoi3 zo2 bin1
